# tree: the unpacked tree under FABLE_THIRDPARTY (never in the repo). tree_sha256: sha256 of the sorted "<sha256>  <relpath>" lines of every file in the
# tree (accepted when a generated archive's own sha256 changes). includes: /I directories relative to the tree, {tag} = another row's tree.
# sources: the linked TUs proven from this source with these flags. not_built: linked TUs that are NOT unmodified-vendor-provable (reason in notes).
# includes may also name an absolute directory by environment variable: $FABLE_WINDDK_INC (default $S/wine/winddk/3790.1830/inc/wnet).
# unpack: empty for a source tarball, or 7z2:<inner exe>|<src dir>=<dst dir>|... for a DirectX SDK installer (fetch_vendor_libs.py).
